string-array.name: keep_running_steps_xiaomi
string-array.item: Open App info and tap Battery saver.
Back in App info, turn on Autostart.

string-array.name: keep_running_steps_samsung
string-array.item: Open App info and tap Battery.
In Settings, Battery, Background usage limits, make sure Flip to Mute is not in Sleeping apps.

string-array.name: keep_running_steps_oppo
string-array.item: Open App info and tap Battery usage.
Turn on Allow auto launch, if your phone shows it.

string-array.name: keep_running_steps_vivo
string-array.item: Open App info and tap Battery.
In iManager or Settings, allow Flip to Mute to auto start.

string-array.name: keep_running_steps_huawei
string-array.item: Find Flip to Mute and turn off Manage automatically.
Turn on Auto-launch, Secondary launch and Run in background.

string-array.name: keep_running_steps_other
string-array.item: Open App info and tap Battery.
Choose Unrestricted, or turn off battery optimisation.
Keep Flip to Mute out of any app cleaner or sleep list.
